what_happened: The risk-bearing residue item (consequence-form carrier normalization, the analogue of validZTime_iff_validInt) compiled sorry-free on the first lean_run_code attempt, mirroring validZTime_iff_validInt's own proof with truthAt_map applied once per premise. The README's 'not known to compile' caveat is discharged for this item.

Compression/README.md:116-121 and Assembly.lean's docstring (lines 55-63) both assert the reduction route is unavailable because the tree has no context-conjunction deduction theorem. StrongCompleteness.lean:262 'semantic_deduction_in' is exactly that theorem in iterated-implication form (SemanticConsequenceIn fc G phi <-> ValidIn fc (G.foldr Formula.imp phi)), generic in the frame class and already proved. A four-line reduction corollary compiles at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The recorded claim is false and must be corrected wherever it appears.

Plan phase inherited a 394-line compiled probe (reports/01_verified-general-form.lean) that already elaborates every headline declaration sorry-free at the required axioms; planning reduced to siting, naming and gate-collision scheduling rather than approach selection.

Plan authoring surfaced three gate collisions the dispatch did not name: .githooks/pre-commit blocks any .lean-staging commit whose typst/generated/status.typ counts are stale (so every Lean phase owns a --fix regen step); C26 forbids the probe-recommended def name decidableSemanticConsequenceZTime_reduction (non-trailing underscore), forcing a rename; and the new StrongCompleteness import into ZTimeProvability.lean may produce surplus upward edges that check-metalogic-cycles.sh Assertion B fails on.

Growing Enumerate.lean by ~90 lines turned two mechanical gates red that the clean baseline had green: C35 (scripts/lean-citation-manifest.json records keyword/span line numbers for cands and mem_cands_of_bounded) and INV (generated inventory blocks in README.md and FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md). C35 names this phase's touched file so it was regenerated in-phase via python3 scripts/export-lean-citations.py; INV names only README files and was left for the plan's scheduled Phase 6 regeneration.
